rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for winning a game, battle, prize, or contest.

example.english: We win the match at last.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 jeng4 zo2 coeng4 bo1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an individual victory.

example.english: We finally got a win in this game.
example.traditional: 今場波我哋終於攞到勝利。
example.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 lo2 dou2 sing3 lei6

rows.note: Use this for a successful outcome or accomplishment rather than a victory itself.

example.english: This project was a success; it was a real win for us.
example.traditional: 呢次計劃成功，對我哋嚟講真係贏咗一仗。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 gai3 waak6 sing4 gung1 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 lei4 gong2 zan1 hai6 jeng4 zo2 jat1 zoeng6

rows.note: Pick this when securing something desired through effort, competition, or negotiation.

example.english: I manage to win the scholarship through hard work.
example.traditional: 我靠努力爭取到份獎學金。
example.jyutping: ngo5 kaau3 nou5 lik6 zang1 ceoi2 dou3 fan6 zoeng2 hok6 gam1

rows.note: Pick this colloquial phrase when winning someone over by coaxing, charming, or persuading them.

example.english: I managed to win the customer over, and they agreed to help us.
example.traditional: 我氹掂咗個客，佢肯幫我哋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tam2 dim6 zo2 go3 haak3 keoi5 hang2 bong1 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this construction when an action or person causes A to win.

example.english: This strategy helps us win the match.
example.traditional: 呢個策略令我哋贏咗場比賽。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 caak3 loek6 ling6 ngo5 dei6 jeng4 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3
